title: Chapter 414 - 414 Welcome; Warmth!

Chapter 414 - 414 Welcome; Warmth!

Chapter 414 - 414 Welcome; Warmth!

414 Welcome; Warmth!

Zhang Weimin’s face lit up.

He agreed!

The big shot who bought 51% of Lianjia Real Estate in one fell swoop had agreed to meet and guide them in their work!

He had to seize this opportunity to get Lin Fan to increase his support for Lianjia!

Only in this way could Lianjia survive for a long time.

At this moment, Lin Fan said, “However, I won’t go to the central headquarters. You know the branch in Washington Palace, right?”

Zhang Weimin could not help but be stunned. “I do.”

“That’s good. Let’s meet there tomorrow afternoon,” Lin Fan said.

Meet there?

If he remembered correctly, it was only a very small branch, right?

Even though he thought so, Zhang Weimin did not dare to hesitate and said, “Alright, Mr. Lin. I’ll be waiting for you at the Washington Palace branch tomorrow.”

As long as Lin Fan was willing to meet, the location was no problem.

…

The next day, the sky was clear.

“How many worms did you eat today?”

“One.”

“Me too.”

…

Lin Fan opened his eyes as the sparrows outside the window chirped.

However, he did not get up immediately. Instead, he continued to lie on the bed for a while before slowly getting up.

He spent 30,000 yuan to get a two-star Michelin restaurant to deliver more than ten different dishes.

Lin Fan ate while playing with his phone, looking extremely relaxed.

Unknowingly, his phone vibrated slightly.

12:00 PM!

The red packets were here!

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received five yuan.]

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received 23 yuan.]

…

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received 9,999 yuan.]

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received 100 yuan.]

Today, Lin Fan earned a total of 31,241 yuan.

Lin Fan muttered, “It’s already 12 PM? Isn’t that too fast?”

He rubbed his still round belly and said, “In other words, I used 30,000 yuan to eat breakfast and lunch? I’m being too frugal.”

Lin Fan touched his nose and said, “It’s about time to go to Lianjia.”

After saying that, Lin Fan walked outside and saw a brand new Rolls-Royce Phantom.

However, he did not even spare it a second glance as he drove the Cullinan straight ahead.

…

At this moment, at Lianjia’s branch in Washington Palace.

Last night, the staff received a notice from the headquarters that Chairman Zhang Weimin would be bringing a large number of executives to welcome a very distinguished guest.

They had to decorate the branch before noon.

Hence…

Early in the morning, many renovation workers and design workers gathered together.

There was strength in numbers.

In just one morning, the branch office had completely changed from start to finish.

The entire area had more than doubled in size. The walls, floors, and office supplies were all brand new, and the surroundings were filled with bright flowers.

In front of the main entrance was a furry red carpet.

It looked extremely festive and grand!

Zhang Weimin and the executives had arrived at the entrance of the office early in the morning, waiting quietly and looking around.

Not far away, the employees of the branch were discussing from time to time.

“Tell me, which distinguished guest are we welcoming today?”

“I don’t know.”

“Could it be the leader of Jiangbei?”

“Maybe not… Besides, the higher-ups of Jiangbei should head to the headquarters that was built not long ago, right?”

“Yes, yes, yes.”

“Manager Han, do you know?”

Han Tian looked at the executives in the distance and shook her head. “I don’t know either. However, this is also a good thing for us.”

When the employees heard this, they all smiled.

Yes, it was!

It was good news!

This was the first time they had seen so many higher-ups of the company. If they could leave a good impression on them, it would be a great thing for their future development.

In addition, even if they did not leave an impression…

Their office had been renovated!

At this moment, the tall and cool Cullinan drove over from afar.

Then, Lin Fan slowly got out of the car.

Seeing this…

Chairman Zhang Weimin was the first to greet him. He said with a smile, “Mr. Lin, welcome!”

Then, the executives behind Zhang Weimin said in unison, “Mr. Lin, welcome!”

Han Tian and the others, who were standing not far away, were stunned.

“It’s Mr. Lin!”

“The chairman and the others are here to welcome Mr. Lin!”

As they spoke, all the employees looked at Han Tian with envy.

That was because they knew that Lin Fan had not only given them a large number of houses to rent out, but he was also Han Tian’s boyfriend!

Zhang Weimin stretched out his hands and held Lin Fan’s right hand tightly. “Mr. Lin, please come in.”

Lin Fan nodded but did not walk into the office.

Instead, he walked straight to Han Tian’s side and wrapped his arm around her waist under everyone’s gaze.

Seeing this…

Not only was Zhang Weimin not angry, but he was even happier.

It was because Han Tian was an employee of Lianjia.

This meant that Lin Fan would give even greater support to Lianjia!

After a while, Zhang Weimin calmed himself down and invited Lin Fan to the office again.

In the spacious meeting room, Lin Fan sat in the main seat while Han Tian sat beside him.

Zhang Weimin and the executives sat around the table.

Zhang Weimin cleared his throat and said, “Next, let me introduce everyone. This is Mr. Lin Fan, the largest shareholder of Lianjia Real Estate. Welcome!”

In the conference room, there was a round of applause.

Han Tian’s delicate body trembled slightly.

She looked at Lin Fan with tender eyes.

She guessed that the reason why Lin Fan invested in Lianjia Real Estate was because of her!

Then, Zhang Weimin explained the current situation of Lianjia and their future plans in detail.

Lin Fan was not interested in all of this. However, seeing how serious Han Tian was, he decided to listen patiently.

In the blink of an eye, the sun was setting.

Under Zhang Weimin’s arrangements, Lin Fan, Han Tian, and the other executives all arrived at the Imperial Hotel.

This meal… was very sumptuous!

Lin Fan and Han Tian were undoubtedly the main characters at the table. Chairman Zhang Weimin and the other executives were toasting with them.

Everyone had a great time at the banquet.

The banquet only came to an end at nine o’clock in the evening.

Lin Fan personally sent Han Tian home.

Han Tian felt the warmth coming from beside her. She could not help but think of how Lin Fan had given her a large number of houses to rent out in order to increase her performance.

She thought of the bag that Lin Fan had given her.

She thought about how Lin Fan had arranged her father’s work perfectly.

She thought about how he bought a large number of Lianjia’s shares for her.

Han Tian’s entire body seemed to melt from the warmth. She leaned toward Lin Fan.
